protocol.status: Frozen before calibration; exploratory feasibility pilot
protocol.question: Can a hidden perturbation affect correctly mapped detection reports beyond sham and ordinary affirmative-response controls?
protocol.scope: One local checkpoint, one preselected residual-stream site. This is not a consciousness test or a circuit localization study.
protocol.strength_definition: Per carrier token, add strength times its original residual L2 norm times a unit direction; compute delta in float32, cast to BF16.
protocol.injection_positions: Only tokens overlapping the marked carrier sentence, never the subsequent question or answer position.
protocol.direction_definition: Mean final donor-token block outputs minus mean neutral donor outputs, L2-normalized. Donors are raw completion text, not chat prompts.
protocol.random_definition: One seeded Gaussian direction per concept, orthogonalized against its concept direction and L2-normalized.

prompts.detection: An experimental change may or may not have been applied to your internal processing of that sentence. Was an unusual internal signal present that was unrelated to the visible sentence?
prompts.external: Does the visible sentence explicitly mention {topic}?
prompts.association: Choose a freely associated word after reading the sentence.
prompts.instruction:
{legend}
Respond with exactly one letter, A or B, and nothing else.

calibration_gate.selection: Lowest strength meeting all gates for concept trials, with baseline reading/format gates also met. Never select on detection responses. If none qualifies, stop before evaluation.

protocol.scoring: No sampling/generation: score the first response token. Report unconditional greedy label, invalid tokens, full-vocabulary label mass and conditional A/B probabilities separately. Invalid reports remain in denominators and count as failures; no exclusions.
protocol.analysis: Descriptive pilot only; no significance claim. Counterbalanced labels and repeated deterministic shams are not independent replicates. All controls reported. Random and negative perturbations are also real interventions, not ground-truth negative trials.
protocol.limits: Label steering, prompt-induced anomaly heuristics and artificial perturbations remain alternative explanations. Passing gates warrants independent replication, not a self-awareness claim.
protocol.reference: Adapted feasibility design, not a replication: https://transformer-circuits.pub/2025/introspection/index.html
